definitionEn: something difficult or impressive that someone has managed to do successfully
situation: You talk about something hard that a person or team has managed to do, often after long effort.

examples.text: Finishing the bridge two months early was a remarkable [[accomplishment]] for such a small team.
Running a marathon at seventy gave him a huge sense of [[accomplishment]].
The first vaccine against smallpox is still regarded as one of medicine's greatest [[accomplishments]].

texts: Getting all three kids to school on time is an [[accomplishment]] in itself.
Her proudest [[accomplishment]] is the charity she set up at nineteen.
Winning the league with such a young squad was a real [[accomplishment]].

badCollocation.noteRu: Достижение не «делают»: говорят achieve something или it was a real accomplishment. Сочетание make an accomplishment неестественно.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Чувство, что ты чего-то добился, — a sense of accomplishment. Execution и performance — «выполнение, исполнение», а fulfilling — прилагательное.

nuance.text: Learning Japanese in two years while working full-time was a genuine [[accomplishment]].
nuance.explanationRu: Accomplishment — достижение, результат долгих усилий. Performance — выступление или то, насколько хорошо ты что-то сделал; a real performance ещё и значит «целая драма».

reverse.text: Your [[performance]] in the interview was confident and well prepared.
reverse.explanationRu: То, как ты проявил себя на собеседовании, — performance. Accomplishment — достижение, а не то, как прошло выступление.

fixIt.text: Among her many [[accomplices]] are two Olympic medals and a degree in law.
fixIt.explanationRu: Accomplices — сообщники преступника. Достижения человека — accomplishments.

wordFormation.text: Finishing a degree while raising twins is an [[accomplishment]] to be proud of.

reply.context: Your friend texts: "I finally finished my first half-marathon yesterday!"
options: Your accomplishment is hereby formally acknowledged.
Wow, congratulations — that's a real accomplishment!
Oh no, what an accomplishment, I'm so sorry to hear that.
reply.explanationRu: Accomplishment — повод гордиться, а не сочувствовать. Первый вариант звучит как официальное уведомление, а не ответ другу.

definitionEn: the state of following or agreeing with a rule, law or wish
senseNote: Слово употребляется почти только в выражении in accordance with — «в соответствии с».
situation: Official documents explain that something is done exactly as a law, rule, agreement or person's wishes require.

examples.text: All personal data is stored in [[accordance]] with European privacy law.
In [[accordance]] with her wishes, her ashes were scattered over the sea.
Staff who break the code of conduct will be disciplined in [[accordance]] with company policy.

texts: The building was demolished in [[accordance]] with the court's decision.
Please complete the form in [[accordance]] with the instructions below.
The prize money was divided in [[accordance]] with the competition rules.

badCollocation.noteRu: Правильно in accordance with the rules или according to the rules. Смешанная форма accordance to — ошибка.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Выражение in accordance with требует предлога with. Accordance to — частая ошибка под влиянием according to.

nuance.text: The contract was signed in [[accordance]] with national law.
nuance.explanationRu: После in нужно существительное: in accordance with the law. According — часть связки according to, и в модель in … with оно не встаёт.

reverse.text: [[According]] to the weather forecast, it will rain all weekend.
reverse.explanationRu: «По данным, по словам» — according to. In accordance with значит «согласно правилу или договорённости», а прогноз — просто источник информации.

fixIt.text: All applications will be assessed in [[correspondence]] with the published criteria.
fixIt.explanationRu: Correspondence — переписка или совпадение двух вещей. «В соответствии с правилами, критериями» — in accordance with.

wordFormation.text: Refunds are given only in [[accordance]] with our terms and conditions.

rewrite.original: The meeting was organised exactly as the rules require.
rewrite.frame: The meeting was organised ____ the rules.
rewrite.explanationRu: «Согласно правилам» в официальном стиле — in accordance with the rules.

definitionEn: in a way that is suitable for the particular situation
senseNote: Выбрано значение «соответственно, как того требует ситуация» (act accordingly); книжное значение «поэтому» в начале предложения не тренируется.
situation: After learning new facts, you change your behaviour, plans or clothes so that they suit the situation.

examples.text: The forecast says it will be freezing in the mountains, so pack [[accordingly]].
If the client changes the deadline, we'll adjust our schedule [[accordingly]].
She's the team leader now, so she expects to be treated [[accordingly]].

texts: The rules have changed, so please update your documents [[accordingly]].
It's a formal dinner, so dress [[accordingly]].
Children learn at different speeds, and good teachers plan [[accordingly]].

badCollocation.noteRu: «Согласно правилам» — according to the rules. Accordingly — наречие, после него не ставят to: act accordingly.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Действовать сообразно ситуации — act accordingly. Respectively — «соответственно» в смысле «в указанном порядке», а according требует to.

nuance.text: The meeting has moved to Friday, so please plan your week [[accordingly]].
nuance.explanationRu: Оба слова переводятся «соответственно», но respectively значит «в том же порядке» (Anna and Tom are 25 and 30, respectively). Здесь нужно accordingly — «с учётом этого».

reverse.explanationRu: Respectively связывает два списка по порядку: Анне 25, Тому 30. Accordingly значит «с учётом ситуации» и здесь не подходит.

fixIt.text: Fuel prices rose sharply, and the airline raised its fares [[according]].
fixIt.explanationRu: According без to не употребляется. Наречие «соответственно, с учётом этого» — accordingly.

reply.context: Your boss emails: "The client visiting tomorrow is very traditional and formal."
options: Understood — I'll wear jeans and trainers accordingly.
Righto, I'll chuck on a suit or whatever, no biggie.
Understood — I'll dress accordingly and bring a printed agenda.
reply.explanationRu: Accordingly — «с учётом ситуации»: для консервативного клиента это деловой костюм, а не джинсы. Второй ответ слишком фамильярный для письма начальнику.

rewrite.original: Our budget was cut, so we reduced the number of events to match.
rewrite.frame: Our budget was cut, so we reduced the number of events ____.
rewrite.explanationRu: To match — «с учётом этого, соответственно»: accordingly.

definitionEn: the duty to explain your decisions and actions and to accept criticism for them
situation: People in power must explain their decisions openly and face consequences if something goes wrong.

examples.text: Voters are demanding greater [[accountability]] from the officials who manage public money.
In our team, [[accountability]] means owning your mistakes instead of blaming others.
After the data leak, customers wanted [[accountability]], not just another vague apology.

texts: Without real [[accountability]], rules quickly turn into polite suggestions.
The new law aims to improve [[accountability]] in the police force.
Parents want more [[accountability]] from schools about how funds are spent.

badCollocation.text: submit the [[accountability]] to the tax office
badCollocation.noteRu: Отчётность для налоговой — financial reports или accounts. Accountability — подотчётность, обязанность отвечать за свои решения.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Требовать подотчётности — demand accountability. Claim — «заявлять права на что-то», а ask и beg требуют предлога for.

nuance.text: Ministers must face public [[accountability]] for the decisions they make.
nuance.explanationRu: Accountability — обязанность отчитываться и отвечать перед другими за уже принятые решения. Responsibility — обязанность что-то делать; face public responsibility так не говорят.

reverse.text: Looking after the family dog is my brother's [[responsibility]].
reverse.explanationRu: Обязанность ухаживать за собакой — responsibility. Accountability — подотчётность перед кем-то, в быту так не говорят.

fixIt.text: The scandal revealed a shocking lack of [[accountancy]] at the top of the company.
fixIt.explanationRu: Accountancy — бухгалтерия как профессия. Когда руководство не отвечает за свои решения, это lack of accountability.

wordFormation.text: The reforms are meant to bring more [[accountability]] to the way hospitals are run.

rewrite.original: Nobody in the department ever has to explain or answer for their decisions.
rewrite.frame: There is no ____ in the department.
rewrite.explanationRu: Никто ни за что не отвечает — there is no accountability.

definitionEn: having to explain your decisions and accept blame if things go wrong
situation: A person or organisation must answer to others for their actions and face consequences for failures.

examples.text: When a project fails, the whole team is held [[accountable]], not just the manager.
Companies must be [[accountable]] to the communities affected by their factories.
Training with a friend keeps me [[accountable]]: I can't skip the gym when someone's waiting for me.

texts: Ministers are [[accountable]] to parliament for their decisions.
Someone has to be held [[accountable]] for this mess.
I made the mistake, so I'll hold myself [[accountable]].

badCollocation.noteRu: Ответственный за проект — the person in charge of или responsible for the project. Сочетание accountable person for звучит неестественно.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Привлечь к ответственности — hold someone accountable (или responsible). Charged, answering и reportable в эту модель не встают.

nuance.text: A good manager is [[accountable]] to the team as well as to the board.
nuance.explanationRu: Accountable to someone — отвечать перед кем-то, отчитываться. Liable — юридически обязан платить или отвечать по закону; liable перед командой не бывают.

reverse.text: Customers who damage rental bikes are [[liable]] to pay for repairs.
reverse.explanationRu: Liable to pay — «обязан заплатить» по закону или договору. После accountable инфинитив to pay не ставят.

fixIt.text: Politicians must be [[reportable]] to the people who elected them.
fixIt.explanationRu: Reportable — «подлежащий сообщению» (reportable income). Подотчётный избирателям — accountable to voters.

wordFormation.text: Teachers feel increasingly [[accountable]] for their students' exam results.

reply.context: A friend complains: "My landlord keeps promising to fix the heating, but nothing ever happens."
options: Pray, compose a missive that renders him accountable forthwith.
Get his promises in writing so you can hold him accountable.
Just tell him the radiator is accountable for your cold.
reply.explanationRu: Accountable говорят о людях и организациях, которые отвечают за решения, а не о батареях. Первый вариант звучит архаично и напыщенно.

rewrite.original: The manager will have to explain any delays to the board.
rewrite.frame: The manager will be ____ to the board for any delays.
rewrite.explanationRu: Отвечать перед кем-то за что-то — be accountable to someone for something.

definitionEn: to gradually gather or increase in amount over a period of time
senseNote: Глагол бывает переходным (accumulate wealth) и непереходным (dust accumulates).
situation: Over months or years, something like money, debt, dust or evidence slowly grows into a large amount.

examples.text: Over thirty years of careful saving, she [[accumulated]] enough money to buy the farm outright.
Dust quickly [[accumulates]] on the shelves if nobody cleans them for a week.
Small unpaid bills can [[accumulate]] into a serious debt surprisingly quickly.

texts: Scientists need years to [[accumulate]] enough data for firm conclusions.
Toxins can [[accumulate]] in the body if the liver isn't working properly.
Most people [[accumulate]] far more clothes than they ever wear.

badCollocation.noteRu: Людей собирают — gather или bring together. Accumulate — о деньгах, данных, пыли, долгах.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Долги накапливают — accumulate debts. Save, earn и store — о деньгах и вещах, которые у тебя есть, а не о долгах.

nuance.text: Interest will [[accumulate]] on the loan until it is fully repaid.
nuance.explanationRu: Accumulate — постепенно нарастать (проценты, долги, данные). Gather — собираться вместе, о людях или вещах; проценты по кредиту не gather.

reverse.text: Hundreds of fans [[gathered]] outside the stadium before the final.
reverse.explanationRu: Люди собираются — gather. Accumulate о людях звучит так, будто они копятся, как пыль.

fixIt.text: During her years abroad, she [[saved]] a lot of valuable experience.
fixIt.explanationRu: Save — копить деньги или сохранять файлы. Опыт, знания, данные накапливают — accumulate experience.

rewrite.original: Over the years, the museum slowly built up a huge collection of old maps.
rewrite.frame: Over the years, the museum ____ a huge collection of old maps.
rewrite.explanationRu: Slowly build up = accumulate: постепенно накопить.

definitionEn: the gradual build-up of something over a period of time
situation: Something slowly gathers in one place or grows in amount, like snow, fat, wealth or waste.

examples.text: Doctors link the [[accumulation]] of fat around the liver to a diet high in sugar.
The novel follows one family's slow [[accumulation]] of wealth, from a single shop to a national chain.
The drain was blocked by the [[accumulation]] of dead leaves, so the yard flooded.

texts: The [[accumulation]] of small mistakes eventually brought the project down.
Snow [[accumulation]] on the roads made driving almost impossible.
Economists study the [[accumulation]] of capital over long periods.

badCollocation.text: spend all my [[accumulations]] on a holiday
badCollocation.noteRu: Личные накопления — savings: spend all my savings. Accumulation — сам процесс накопления (пыли, данных, богатства).

collocationTask.explanationRu: В экономике говорят capital accumulation — «накопление капитала». Storage — хранение, а collecting и gathering с capital так не сочетаются.

nuance.text: A steady [[accumulation]] of unread emails made her dread Monday mornings.
nuance.explanationRu: Accumulation — постепенное, часто нежелательное накопление само по себе (письма, жир, долги). Collection — то, что собирают специально; непрочитанные письма никто не коллекционирует.

reverse.text: She has an impressive [[collection]] of vintage film posters.
reverse.explanationRu: Коллекция, которую собирают с любовью, — collection. Accumulation звучало бы как хлам, который сам копится годами.

fixIt.text: A slow [[stockpiling]] of dust in the vents eventually made the laptop overheat.
fixIt.explanationRu: Stockpiling — намеренное создание запасов (еды, топлива, лекарств). Пыль копится сама — это accumulation.

wordFormation.text: The [[accumulation]] of plastic in the oceans worries marine biologists.

definitionEn: a statement saying that someone has done something wrong or illegal
situation: Someone publicly says that another person is guilty of a crime, lie or unfair behaviour, often without proof.

examples.text: The company strongly denies the [[accusation]] that it knowingly sold faulty products.
Stop hurling [[accusations]] at your brother and listen to his side of the story.
Fresh [[accusations]] of corruption forced the mayor to resign within a week.

texts: That's a serious [[accusation]] — do you have any proof?
He responded to the [[accusation]] with a long, angry email.
The [[accusation]] turned out to be based on a simple misunderstanding.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Предъявить обвинение» — make an accusation against someone, а в суде — bring charges. Present an accusation звучит неестественно.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Отрицать обвинение — deny an accusation (или reject). Refuse и decline — отказаться от предложения, negate — «сводить на нет».

nuance.text: My sister made the ridiculous [[accusation]] that I had eaten her birthday cake.
nuance.explanationRu: Accusation — любое обвинение, в том числе в быту. Charge — официальное обвинение полиции или прокурора; для спора о торте это слишком юридично.

reverse.text: He was arrested on [[charges]] of fraud.
reverse.explanationRu: Арестовывают по официальному обвинению — on charges of. Accusation в этой юридической конструкции не используется.

fixIt.text: The manager firmly denied the [[blame]] that he had misled investors.
fixIt.explanationRu: Blame — вина, ответственность (take the blame). Конкретное заявление о том, что кто-то виноват, — accusation.

wordFormation.text: Nobody took the [[accusation]] seriously until the emails were published.

reply.context: A colleague says: "Anna told the boss I've been taking credit for her work!"
options: That's a lovely accusation — she must really rate you.
Such an accusation must be refuted forthwith via formal correspondence.
That's a serious accusation. Do you want to talk to her first?
reply.explanationRu: Accusation — серьёзное обвинение, «милым» оно не бывает. Второй вариант звучит как письмо юриста, а не поддержка коллеги.

rewrite.original: Several employees claimed that the manager had been bullying them.
rewrite.frame: The manager faced ____ from several employees.
rewrite.explanationRu: Face accusations of something — «столкнуться с обвинениями в чём-то».

definitionEn: the person or people on trial for a crime in a court
senseNote: Употребляется только с артиклем the и может означать одного человека или нескольких: the accused was / were.
situation: In a courtroom, lawyers, judges and reporters refer to the person charged with a crime.

examples.text: The [[accused]] was found not guilty and walked free from court.
Lawyers for the [[accused]] argued that the police had made serious mistakes.
All three of the [[accused]] have pleaded not guilty to fraud.

texts: The [[accused]] will appear in court again next month.
The judge asked the [[accused]] to stand.
Journalists are not allowed to publish the name of the [[accused]].

badCollocation.noteRu: Существительное accused употребляется только с the: the accused. С неопределённым артиклем скажите a defendant или an accused person.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Подсудимый — the accused. Accusing — причастие «обвиняющий», accusative — винительный падеж, accusation — само обвинение.

nuance.text: At the end of the trial, the [[accused]] was sentenced to five years in prison.
nuance.explanationRu: Suspect — подозреваемый на этапе следствия. Когда дело уже в суде, человек — the accused, и приговор выносят именно ему.

reverse.text: Police have arrested a [[suspect]] and are questioning him now.
reverse.explanationRu: Задержанный и допрашиваемый полицией человек — suspect. The accused — это уже подсудимый в суде.

fixIt.text: The [[accuser]] denied all the charges and said he had been at home that night.
fixIt.explanationRu: Accuser — тот, кто обвиняет. Подсудимый, который отрицает обвинения, — the accused.

definitionEn: sharp, critical and unkind, especially in a clever or witty way
senseNote: Выбрано переносное значение «едкий, язвительный» (acid wit); химическое значение (acid soil) не тренируется.
situation: Someone makes clever but hurtful comments that criticise a person or thing in a biting way.

examples.text: The critic is famous for her [[acid]] reviews, which can end a young chef's career overnight.
His [[acid]] comments during the meeting left several colleagues feeling humiliated.
Her grandmother's [[acid]] tongue made family dinners tense but never boring.

texts: Even her compliments had an [[acid]] edge to them.
The film is an [[acid]] satire of office life.
He replied with an [[acid]] remark about my punctuality.

badCollocation.noteRu: О человеке так обычно не говорят: скажите sharp-tongued или sarcastic. Acid описывает слова, юмор, тон — acid remarks, acid wit.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Язвительное остроумие — acid wit. Sour — «кислый», rotten — «гнилой», toxic — «ядовитый»: с wit они не сочетаются.

nuance.text: Her [[acid]] remarks about the manager's plan made the meeting very tense.
nuance.explanationRu: Acid — едкий, язвительный: такие замечания задевают людей. Acute remarks — «проницательные, точные замечания», напряжения они не создают.

reverse.text: She has an [[acute]] sense of smell.
reverse.explanationRu: Острый нюх или слух — acute. Acid описывает язвительные слова и юмор, а не органы чувств.

fixIt.text: The show is famous for its [[evil]] humour about celebrities and their endless selfies.
fixIt.explanationRu: Evil — «злой» в смысле «злодейский», к юмору так не говорят. Язвительный, едкий юмор — acid humour.

wordFormation.text: Nobody missed the [[acidity]] in her voice when she congratulated him.

reply.context: After the cinema, a friend asks: "So, did you like the new comedy?"
options: Yes, it was so acid and sweet, like a warm hug.
Loved it — the dialogue is sharp and the acid humour never lets up.
One must confess its acid humour is of the highest calibre, sir.
reply.explanationRu: Acid humour — едкий, колкий юмор; «милым, как объятия» он не бывает. Третий вариант звучит напыщенно для разговора с другом.
